Enum Class HttpStatus

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<HttpStatus>
org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<HttpStatus>, Constable, HttpStatusCode
public enum HttpStatus extends Enum<HttpStatus> implements HttpStatusCode
Enumeration of HTTP status codes.

HTTP 状态码系列可以通过series()获取。

Since:
3.0
Author:
Arjen Poutsma, Sebastien Deleuze, Brian Clozel
